NEW FUND MANAGEMENT SYSTEM 
Under the NFMS, following procedure have been laid down: 
In respect of those bank accounts wherein NFMS has been implemented, the nature of 
Trustees' bank accounts would be Current A/c instead of Savings A/c. 
All the cheques issued by the field offices would be honored by the respective link 
branches irrespective to the balance available in the bank A/c; 
At the end of the working day, whatever would be the closing balance in the accounts of 
field offices, whether Debit or Credit, would be on-line transferred using auto sweep by all 
the link branches to the Central Investment Accounts of the Trustees' maintained with SBI-
Main Branch Mumbai, leaving NIL balance in the accounts at Link Branch. All the transfers 
(Debit / Credit) made by the field offices would be effected in the respective Central 
Investment Accounts on the same day; 
In case, there is surplus (Credit Balance) as the net balance in any Central Investment 
Account then the same would be transferred to Security Services Branch of SBI at Mumbai 
for investment on the same day; 
In case, there is deficit (Debit Balance) as the net balance in any Central Investment 
Account then the same will be taken care of out the consolidated overdraft limit extended 
by the SBI-Main Branch, Mumbai to EPFO; 
Any overdraft limit availed by EPFO on a particular day, would be squared off against the 
surplus / inflows taken place on the immediate next day. Till this overdraft is squared off, 
interest -would be charged by SBI on outstanding amount at a mutually agreed / specified 
rate. 
The overdraft limit may be increased / decreased at point of time with the mutual consent 
of both the parties, considering the requirements of EPFO. 
Although, there is a provision for auto transfer of daily closing balance from link branch to 
SBI-Mumbai Main Branch, it would be the responsibility of the concerned link branch to 
transfer the daily closing balance {Debit / Credit} to SBI-Mumbai Main Branch. 
If Link Branch does not transfer any credit balance available on the same day, a penal 
interest of 4% over and above the prevailing SBI Saving Bank Interest rate would be 
payable on such amount retained by the SBI till it is transferred to Central Investment 
Accounts. However, In case the link branch does not transfer any Debit balance there will 
not be any charge on EPFO as the transfer of balance is the sole responsibility of SBI Link 
Branches. 
There will not be any additional charges on the transfer of daily closing balances by the link 
branches to SBI-Mumbai Main Branch or vice versa. 
The link branches shall provide the Regional Offices, Sub-Regional offices, the particulars 
of balance available in the accounts maintained by them on daily basis and that the link 
branches shall provide the facility of Remote log in / Internet Banking (wherever available) 
to the respective field offices without any additional charges. 
Settlement with regard to payment of service charges and claim of interest for delayed 
credit, clearance of missing credits, un-reconciled amount or amount in transit pertaining to 
past period shall be in accordance with the mechanism agreed in February 1998, the 
relevant extracts of the same are as per Annexure- II.
